q1_issues.issue: The four coordinated objects are stacked as four Theme atoms on one track event, but coordinated noun phrases are distributive by default and the whole predication should be replicated once per conjunct; multiple same-role atoms on a single event are licensed only for the collective (multiple-Agent) reading, which 'track' does not trigger.

The definite plural 'the records' gets the group witness and group event but no per-member distribution rule over (PartOf $x sk_group_1), which a grouped plural with a distributive predicate requires ('track' is not one of the collective predicates, though the collective reading is arguable here).

notes: Compound handling is right on all four objects (head genus emitted, noun modifiers unexposed), the bare kind fillers fit the non-specific habitual clause, and the inanimate transitive subject correctly stays Agent. Every worked coordination example in the instruction set coordinates subjects, so the expansion of a four-item object list rests on the general distributive rule alone.
